verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's agent capabilities are tied to the Copilot subscription itself. Plan features include "Access to Cloud agent and code review", and partner agent apps are "powered by your Copilot subscription", so no separate API billing is implied. The coding agent is available across IDE agent mode, the cloud agent and the CLI. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the sign-in/authentication flow tying a plan to the agent in each surface, a per-plan breakdown of which tiers include agent access, and independent hands-on corroboration.
